commands.name: connection
commands.description:
Manage live backend connections for diagnostics and Windows E2E validation.

Use `adv device list -o json` to find connectionId values. Platform aliases such as `first`, `desktop`, `windows`, `macos`, `ios`, `watchos`, and `web` are also accepted.

Close asks a supported Advantage CLI worker to shut down gracefully. Drop removes the connection from backend state immediately for stale-connection cleanup and reconnection tests.

Examples:
  adv connection close <connectionId> --reason "E2E cleanup"
  adv connection drop windows --reason "Windows E2E reconnection test"
  adv --local connection close <connectionId>
